title: Symbol read from the counter tape
statement: For any Boolean word $y$, access state $st$, and natural numbers $i,k,p,q$, the symbol under the head of work tape $2$ in the corresponding access configuration is the first bit, if any, of the binary expansion of $k$ after its first $q$ bits are dropped.
hypotheses_covered: natural numbers i, k, p, q
